# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in Zing, please do not open a GitHub issue.

Instead, please report it to through GitHub's security advisory feature.

https://github.com/CollinsFabian/Zing/security/advisories/new

Please include:
- A description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce it
- The affected version(s)
- Any relevant code or proof of concept
- The potential impact, if known
I will review security reports as soon as reasonably possible.

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are currently provided for the latest released version of Zing.
